terms.gloss: one would have thought, you would have believed
terms.grammar: second person singular, imperfect subjunctive (potential of the past)
evidence: Liv. 2.43.9: victōs crēderēs, one would have thought them beaten (Lewis & Short s.v. crēdō)
terms.comment: The indefinite “you” of the potential subjunctive; so also putārēs, dīcerēs.

sources: Lewis & Short: credo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 354.
